name: ui_ux_pro_max
description: Design and review interfaces against a concrete house style rather than taste.
when_to_use: Building or reviewing a user interface, when the question is which spacing, colour or component to use.
instructions: Read the resource that covers the decision you are making before making it.
Quote the rule you followed next to the change, so a reviewer can check it.
Prefer an existing component over a new one, and an existing token over a new value.
State plainly when a requirement conflicts with the house style, rather than silently choosing one.
constraints: Never invent a spacing or colour value that is not in the scale.
Never claim a contrast ratio without computing it.

resources.title: Colour contrast, with the ratios worked out
